0d00a53b5550a5f409891471880956f3a4b060c3.definition: The property of a set of axioms that do not contradict one another.
0d00a53b5550a5f409891471880956f3a4b060c3.gloss: The property of a set of axioms that do not contradict one another.

0d00a53b5550a5f409891471880956f3a4b060c3.definition: 하나의 명제 집합에 속한 명제들이 서로 논리적으로 모순되지 않는 성질이다. 모순이 없으면 그 명제들로부터 논리적으로 타당한 결론을 얻을 수 있다.
0d00a53b5550a5f409891471880956f3a4b060c3.gloss: 어떤 공리 집합의 명제들이 서로 모순되지 않는 성질이다.

0d00a53b5550a5f409891471880956f3a4b060c3.definition: Propriedade de um conjunto de axiomas ou regras em que nenhum deles contradiz os demais. Um conjunto inconsistente pode levar a qualquer conclusão, sem valor demonstrativo.
0d00a53b5550a5f409891471880956f3a4b060c3.gloss: Propriedade de um conjunto de axiomas que não se contradizem entre si.

0d00a53b5550a5f409891471880956f3a4b060c3.definition: Sifat suatu himpunan aksioma yang tidak saling bertentangan. Jika dua pernyataan dalam himpunan itu saling meniadakan, himpunan tersebut tidak konsisten.
0d00a53b5550a5f409891471880956f3a4b060c3.gloss: Sifat suatu himpunan aksioma yang tidak saling bertentangan.

0d00a53b5550a5f409891471880956f3a4b060c3.definition: คุณสมบัติของชุดบทสมมติฐานหรือกฎที่ไม่ขัดแย้งกัน หากข้อความสองข้อที่ต่างกันขัดแย้งกัน ชุดนั้นจะไม่สอดคล้องกัน
0d00a53b5550a5f409891471880956f3a4b060c3.gloss: คุณสมบัติของชุดบทสมมติฐานที่ไม่ขัดแย้งกัน

0d00a53b5550a5f409891471880956f3a4b060c3.definition: Bir aksiyom kümesinde hiçbir önermenin başka bir önermeyle çelişmemesi hâli. Çelişki varsa küme tutarlı değildir.
0d00a53b5550a5f409891471880956f3a4b060c3.gloss: Birbirleriyle çelişmeyen aksiyomlardan oluşan bir kümenin özelliği.

0d00a53b5550a5f409891471880956f3a4b060c3.definition: 一連の公理や規則の間で矛盾が生じないという性質。矛盾があれば、それらすべてを同時に真とはできない。
0d00a53b5550a5f409891471880956f3a4b060c3.gloss: 複数の公理や規則が互いに矛盾しない性質。

0d00a53b5550a5f409891471880956f3a4b060c3.translation: 二つの規則が同時に真でありえないなら、その規則の集合は整合的ではない。
İki kural aynı anda doğru olamaz; bu yüzden kural kümesi tutarlı değildir.
กฎสองข้อไม่อาจเป็นจริงพร้อมกันได้ ดังนั้นชุดกฎนี้จึงไม่สอดคล้องกัน
Kedua aturan itu tidak mungkin sama-sama benar, sehingga himpunan aturan tersebut tidak konsisten.
As duas regras não podem ser verdadeiras ao mesmo tempo, portanto o conjunto de regras não é consistente.
두 규칙이 동시에 참일 수 없으므로 그 규칙 집합은 일관적이지 않다.

0d00a53b5550a5f409891471880956f3a4b060c3.text: The two rules cannot both be true, so the set of rules is not consistent.
0d00a53b5550a5f409891471880956f3a4b060c3.translation: Hai quy tắc không thể cùng đúng, nên tập hợp các quy tắc đó không nhất quán.

0d8101f9fe6a2cd3fa5e5cbb8b9ed616681a5988.definition: The accumulated gap between the sleep you have had and the sleep you need. It can be partly repaid, but slowly.
0d8101f9fe6a2cd3fa5e5cbb8b9ed616681a5988.gloss: The accumulated gap between the sleep you have had and the sleep you need. It can be partly repaid, but slowly.

0d8101f9fe6a2cd3fa5e5cbb8b9ed616681a5988.definition: 本来必要な睡眠時間よりVolt眠れた時間の不足が累積したものを指す。多少は回復できるものの、alignmentに時間がかかる。
0d8101f9fe6a2cd3fa5e5cbb8b9ed616681a5988.gloss: 必要な睡眠量との差が積み重なった状態。

0d8101f9fe6a2cd3fa5e5cbb8b9ed616681a5988.definition: 필요한 수면량에 비해 부족한 수면이 시간으로 누적된 상태다. 더 긴 잠으로 일부 회복할 수 있지만 완전히 메우기는 어렵다.
Representa a falta de sono acumulada ao longo do tempo. Pode ser recuperada, mas normalmente de forma gradual.
0d8101f9fe6a2cd3fa5e5cbb8b9ed616681a5988.gloss: Acúmulo da diferença entre a quantidade de sono desejada e a quantidade efetivamente dormida.

0d8101f9fe6a2cd3fa5e5cbb8b9ed616681a5988.definition: Utang tidur terbentuk ketika kebutuhan tidur tidak terpenuhi secara terus-menerus. Kekurangannya dapat dipulihkan secara bertahap, tetapi biasanya tidak dapat dihilangkan dengan satu malam tidur panjang.
0d8101f9fe6a2cd3fa5e5cbb8b9ed616681a5988.gloss: Akumulasi kekurangan tidur dibandingkan dengan jumlah tidur yang dibutuhkan.

0d8101f9fe6a2cd3fa5e5cbb8b9ed616681a5988.definition: ระยะเวลาการนอนที่ควรได้รับแต่ไม่ได้นอนจนสะสมขึ้น สามารถทยอยชดเชยได้ แต่ต้องใช้เวลา

0d8101f9fe6a2cd3fa5e5cbb8b9ed616681a5988.gloss: Gerçekleşen uyku ile ihtiyaç duyulan uyku arasındaki biriken farktır.

0d8101f9fe6a2cd3fa5e5cbb8b9ed616681a5988.translation: Üç haftadır erken kalktığım için uyku borcum birikiyor.

0d8101f9fe6a2cd3fa5e5cbb8b9ed616681a5988.text: I have been building up sleep debt for three weeks of early starts.

0d8101f9fe6a2cd3fa5e5cbb8b9ed616681a5988.text: I have been building up sleep debt for three weeks of early starts.
0d8101f9fe6a2cd3fa5e5cbb8b9ed616681a5988.translation: Passei três semanasstarting cedo e acumulando dívida de sono.

0d8101f9fe6a2cd3fa5e5cbb8b9ed616681a5988.text: I have been building up sleep debt for three weeks of early starts.
0d8101f9fe6a2cd3fa5e5cbb8b9ed616681a5988.translation: 세 주 연속 일찍 일어나면서 수면 부족이 쌓였습니다.

0d8101f9fe6a2cd3fa5e5cbb8b9ed616681a5988.text: I have been building up sleep debt for three weeks of early starts.
0d8101f9fe6a2cd3fa5e5cbb8b9ed616681a5988.translation: 三週間朝が早いため、睡眠負債が積み重なっています。

0dc23e11c62e265af4feb0db03cf5d9e8549ff6c.text: In EUR/USD the euro is the base currency and the dollar is the quote currency.

0df74358b94108e9fd1a07e5cc603cb3f397bdb6.definition: An estimate of how many eggs remain in the ovaries, built from hormone measurements and sometimes a scan.
0df74358b94108e9fd1a07e5cc603cb3f397bdb6.gloss: An estimate of how many eggs remain in the ovaries, built from hormone measurements and sometimes a scan.

0df74358b94108e9fd1a07e5cc603cb3f397bdb6.definition: ホルモン値や卵巣の画像検査をもとに、卵巣予備能を推定する指標。卵の数や妊娠確率そのものを直接示すわけではない。
0df74358b94108e9fd1a07e5cc603cb3f397bdb6.gloss: 卵巣に残っている卵の数を、ホルモン検査や画像検査から推定した値。

0df74358b94108e9fd1a07e5cc603cb3f397bdb6.definition: 호르몬 검사와 필요할 경우 초음파를 바탕으로 난소 예비력을 추정한다. 난자의 현재 재고를 가늠하는 값이며 임신 확률 자체를 나타내는 것은 아니다.
0df74358b94108e9fd1a07e5cc603cb3f397bdb6.gloss: 난소에 남아 있는 난자의 양을 추정한 값.

0df74358b94108e9fd1a07e5cc603cb3f397bdb6.definition: Cadangan ovarium adalah perkiraan jumlah sel telur yang tersisa, yang biasanya dihitung dari pengukuran hormon dan kadang pemindaian. Perkiraan ini menggambarkan jumlah cadangan, bukan peluang hamil.
0df74358b94108e9fd1a07e5cc603cb3f397bdb6.gloss: Perkiraan jumlah sel telur yang masih tersisa di ovarium.

0df74358b94108e9fd1a07e5cc603cb3f397bdb6.definition: ค่าประเมินที่แสดงประมาณจำนวนไข่ที่เหลือในรังไข่ คำนวณจากค่าฮอร์โมนและบางครั้งอาจใช้ภาพสแกนร่วมด้วย ค่านี้ไม่ใช่โอกาสตั้งครรภ์โดยตรง
0df74358b94108e9fd1a07e5cc603cb3f397bdb6.gloss: การประเมินปริมาณไข่ที่เหลืออยู่ในรังไข่

0df74358b94108e9fd1a07e5cc603cb3f397bdb6.definition: Yumurtalık rezervi, hormon ölçümlerinden ve bazen bir görüntülemeden yararlanılarak kalan yumurta miktarının tahmin edilmesidir. Gerçek yumurta sayısını doğrudan göstermez ve gebe kalma olasılığı anlamına gelmez.
0df74358b94108e9fd1a07e5cc603cb3f397bdb6.gloss: Yumurtalıklarda yaklaşık olarak kaç yumurta kaldığının tahmini.

0df74358b94108e9fd1a07e5cc603cb3f397bdb6.definition: Estimativa baseada em dosagens hormonais e, às vezes, em ultrassonografia para avaliar a quantidade de óvulos restantes nos ovários. Não indica diretamente a chance de engravidar.
0df74358b94108e9fd1a07e5cc603cb3f397bdb6.gloss: Estimativa da quantidade de óvulos que ainda permanecem nos ovários.

0df74358b94108e9fd1a07e5cc603cb3f397bdb6.translation: A estimativa da reserva ovariana descreve a quantidade provável de óvulos restantes, mas não a chance de engravidar.
Yumurtalık rezervi tahmini bir stok betimler; gebe kalma olasılığını söylemez.
ผลประเมินปริมาณไข่ที่เหลือในรังไข่บอกขนาดคลังไข่ แต่ไม่ได้บอกว่าจะตั้งครรภ์ได้แน่นอน
Perkiraan cadangan ovarium menggambarkan jumlah cadangan sel telur, bukan peluang mendapat kehamilan.
검사로 난소 예비력을 추정했지만 임신 확률은 별도로 알려 주었다.
卵巣予備能の推定値は在庫のようなもので、妊娠確率をそのまま示すものではない。

0df74358b94108e9fd1a07e5cc603cb3f397bdb6.text: The ovarian reserve estimate describes a stock; it is not a statement about the odds.
